title: Predictable randomness via mt_rand (php) — review required
description: The php call mt_rand draws from a non-cryptographic generator. Its output is predictable from past values or seed, so tokens, nonces, and temporary secrets built on it can be guessed. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the value is non-security or switches to random_int / random_bytes.
remediation: Draw security values from random_int / random_bytes. Keep the fast generator only for simulations, games, and sampling with a comment saying so.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches any mt_rand call regardless of purpose; no-arg generator forms are separate rules.
